(3) The shot returns to a medium close-up framing. He continues his monologue with a serious but animated demeanor, his eyes darting slightly as he makes a financial argument. He looks away occasionally as if contemplating, then snaps back to look at the camera. His posture is relaxed, but his facial expressions remain very active and expressive. (7) He leans in for a final shout, then begins to shake his head and upper body rapidly in a humorous, jittery motion. He looks extremely agitated for comedic effect. (8) The video transitions to a black screen overlay featuring a circular photo of a man and a woman in the center, with white and red text below it providing a call to action.
